C01 concerns the same report but is chiefly a general commendation, while C17 establishes the earlier commission and its assignment rather than the follow-up machinery reflected in the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the work they have done in answer to my request for advice regarding actions deemed appropriate in implementing the recommendations of the President's Materials Policy Commission","parent_excerpt":"I am requesting the various Government agencies to make a detailed study of these recommendations","explanation":"The child expressly describes the completed work initiated by C15's request for agency study of the Commission's recommendations."},{"child_excerpt":"This evaluation by the Board, together with the individual comments submitted by the agencies concerned with materials and energy policies and programs","parent_excerpt":"I am directing the National Security Resources Board to assume the responsibility of coordinating the findings and of maintaining a continuing review of materials policies and programs","explanation":"Both use the same Board-led mechanism for coordinating agency findings and reviewing materials policies and programs."},{"child_excerpt":"represents an important step in marking out the future role of the Federal Government in this important field","parent_excerpt":"as a guide to public policy and private endeavor.
